g.text: Common-epoch target positions in chief RTN

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444e59

g.text: 12 × 4 kg 3U; releases every 450 s from 450 to 5400 s, within one nominal 500 km SSO orbit.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444e59

g.text: Full PV targets are evaluated at 91800 s: 24 h after final release. RTN points are target positions; labels mark selected release indices.
